select ifnull(sum(money),0) from pay_details where `state`=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select count(*) from tb_user t where 1=1
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
select tu.*,uc.status as status1 from tb_user tu left join user_certification uc on uc.user_id = tu.user_id where tu.user_id = #{userId}

select u.user_name as userName, u.avatar as avatar, u.user_id as userId, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(money),0) FROM `user_money_details` m WHERE m.relation_id = u.user_id
AND m.user_level = 1
AND m.user_level = 2
)AS money FROM tb_user u, tb_user ua WHERE 1 = 1
and u.inviter_code = ua.invitation_code
and u.inviter_inviter_code = ua.invitation_code
and ua.user_id = #{userId} order by money desc

select u.*, (select count(*) from sc_follow l where u.user_id = l.user_id and classify = 3) as followCount, (select count(*) from sc_follow c where c.by_id = u.user_id and classify = 3) as fansCount, (select count(*) from goods g where g.user_id = u.user_id and g.good_status = 0 and g.status = 1 and g.is_enable = 1) as goodsCount, (select count(*) from trends t where t.user_id = u.user_id and t.status = 1) as trendsCount, (select count(*) from trends_like l where t.trends_id = l.trends_id and l.comment_id is null) as likeCount, (select count(*) from trends_comment c where c.trends_id = t.trends_id) as commentsCount, (select case when exists(select 1 from trends_like l where t.trends_id = l.trends_id and l.user_id = #{userId} and l.comment_id is null)THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isLike, (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sc_follow f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.by_id = u.user_id AND f.classify = 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isFollow from tb_user u LEFT JOIN trends t ON u.user_id = t.user_id where u.user_id = #{byUserId} GROUP BY u.user_id
